note: Each button runs the TV lane's own runner, tvbot/bot/run.py, with a fixed argument list. The desk serves one request at a time, so two buttons never run at once.

actions.name: replay-fresh
actions.label: Run the replay from scratch
actions.note: Clears tvbot/out/normal and replays the sample bars. Fills at the next bar, after costs.

actions.name: replay-again
actions.label: Rerun (should add nothing)
actions.note: Replays the same bars into the same folder. Every bar should be refused as already recorded.

actions.name: adverse
actions.label: Bad-input check
actions.note: Feeds TradingView-origin, stale, future, duplicate and over-limit inputs on a work copy. Each must be refused.

actions.name: sweep
actions.label: Cost sweep
actions.note: Reruns with costs raised step by step. The net result should fall each time.
